chunks: Speak to the people to give me time until I redress their grievances.
Amir al-mu'minin then said: So far as Medina is concerned there is no question of time.
As for remoter areas you can have the time needed for your order to reach there.

key_terms.عُثْمَانُ: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Caliph

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali determine the appropriate delay for Uthman's governance based on proximity?
ai.summary: This dialogue highlights Imam Ali’s pragmatic approach to governance, distinguishing between immediate local accountability and the logistical reality of distant provinces. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Caliph’s direct responsibility to rectify injustices (Mazalim) as soon as they are brought to his attention, reflecting the principle of timely justice in early Islamic history.
